title: docs(qa): re-point ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate to the per-action sys_* gate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #29892
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：测试清单里"MCP 动作暴露闸"这一项（ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate）升到第 7 版，第 4 条验收和第 6 步改成按动作判定：系统对象上的动作自己声明了 ai.exposed 才会被 AI 列出并执行，没声明的照旧拒绝。
- 为什么改：旧条款还写着"系统对象一律拒绝"，而 #27681、#27900 的裁决早已改为逐动作开放，所以这条 P1 发版证据每轮测试都报 FAIL，把它真正找到的缺陷 #28943 埋在一行常红里。
- 风险与回滚：只改一份清单 JSON，不碰产品代码，回滚就是 revert 本 PR；条款强度不降，仍要求看到一个未声明的系统动作被拒且零副作用，同时看到一个已声明的动作被放行。
- 先看：docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json 该项的 acceptance[4]（拒绝半与放行半），其次 steps[6] 和新增的 fixtures.requires[4]。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK` 并以 0 退出。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One item revision in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json`: `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate` goes from revision 6 to 7, with a `history` row citing #29892 and the three rulings (6513869839 on #27681, letter B; 6523087116 and 6540309323 on #27900, the ADR-0011 identity-actions addendum).

- **acceptance[4]** no longer says system objects are refused wholesale. It now says a system-object action passes the MCP system-object guard only on its own `ai.exposed`, and it names both halves on `sys_api_key`:
  - refused: `create_api_key` (no `ai` block; a credential-minting action, held human-only by ruling 6513869839 parameter 2) is absent from `list_actions`, is refused in both live spellings (the tool layer's `systemObjectActionRefusal` with `objectName`, the runtime's `systemObjectActionExposureError` without it), and no key is created;
  - exposed: `revoke_api_key` (`ai: { exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true }`, bucket C) is listed with `aiExposed: true` and, called with the admin's session token and `confirm: true`, answers `ok: true` and the probe key reads `revoked: true`.
  The verify names both FAIL shapes: a `sys_*` action with no `ai` block that is listed or runs, and an exposed one refused with either system-object text.
- **steps[6]** names those two actions. "any sys_* action name" can now pick an exposed one, and then the step proves nothing.
- **fixtures.requires[4]** (new, appended, so no index shifts) stages the probe key and the session bearer. Under an `osk_` key, `revoke_api_key` is listed with `unavailable` and refused by its target's credential gate, so the exposed run needs a signed-in session.
- **source** gains three symbol anchors: `systemObjectActionExposureError`, `isListableAction` and `sys-api-key.object.ts#revoke_api_key`. All of them resolve (1134/1144 to 1137/1147 anchors resolved).

Riders from the same rulings, which are deviations from the card's two named fields:
- the **title** said "refuses system objects"; it now says "admits a system-object action only on its own ai.exposed";
- **acceptance[1].verify** called `showcase_portfolio_snapshot` "the one exposed action". The listing now also carries the platform's ai-exposed `sys_*` identity actions, and an entry marked `unavailable` is listed by contract. The clause itself is unchanged. The statement that no exposed action gates a permission still holds, because no `sys_*` action declares `requiredPermissions`.

Left intact on purpose: **negative[1]**, the list/run agreement that found #28943.

## Tests

Docs only, with no product code. The ruled behaviour was read on `main` at `a04e9d76c1`, and the two unit pins that drive it were run on this branch's tree, whose product code is identical to that base:

- `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` L141-158 `systemObjectActionExposureError`: `return null` only on `action?.ai?.exposed === true` (L154), with the refusal text at L156. Its call site in `invokeBusinessAction` is L4260-4261. The runtime listing asks the same predicate at `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` L863.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` L395-397 `isListableAction`, with the refusal text at L399-404. The `list_actions` filter is at L1483 and the `run_action` pre-screen at L1585-1590.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts`: `create_api_key` (L100) has no `ai` block, and `revoke_api_key` (L142) declares `ai.exposed` with `requiresConfirmation: true`.

<details><summary>Unit pins run at dd68162400</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-action-system-object-exposure.test.ts` (under the verify lock, after building the `@objectstack/mcp^...` closure): `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 8 passed (8)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-system-object-action-exposure.test.ts` (after building `@objectstack/runtime^...`): `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 11 passed (11)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Live corroboration, from #29892 at `589049b0` and not re-run here: `create_api_key` was refused in both spellings, and `revoke_api_key` with `confirm: true` under the admin session answered `ok: true`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The new step and clause have not been run live. The first sweep that runs revision 7 proves the recipe.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates at dd68162400 (16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED)</summary>

Every command `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives exited 0: `check-adr-links` (plus `--self-test`), `check-closing-keyword-parity` (plus `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `plan-test-core-shards --self-test`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe` and `check:watch-hint-literal`. The first `check:doc-formula-expressions` run exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`). After `turbo run build` of those two packages it exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reported 16 derived, 16 run and 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero because every line recorded its exit code.
</details>
